releases.label: IPEDS winter release (provisional)
brings: Graduation by Pell and loan status, entering class of fall 2019 (GR2025_PELL_SSL)
releases.basis: Last year's winter release was Dec 9, 2025; SAL2024_IS and DRVF2024 followed on Dec 30, 2025

releases.label: IPEDS directory and institutional characteristics (provisional)
brings: Directory 2026–27 (HD2026): setting, Carnegie classes, designations, locations
Institutional characteristics 2026–27 (IC2026): athletics, ROTC, study abroad, services, calendar
releases.basis: HD2025 was published Jul 21, 2026, and IC2025 Jul 28, 2026

releases.label: IPEDS completions (provisional)
brings: Degrees awarded by field, 2025–26 graduates (C2026_A): most popular majors
releases.basis: C2025_A (2024–25 graduates) was published Jul 28, 2026, with the directory files

releases.label: IPEDS final data (revisions)
releases.basis: Final data follows provisional by about a year: last year's winter finals came Dec 9, 2025, and this collection's fall finals on Sep 8, 2026
releases.note: Same years as the site shows now, with colleges' corrections

releases.label: IPEDS spring release (provisional)
releases.basis: Last year's spring release was Jan 6, 2026
releases.note: Transfer students update directly; other enrollment figures reach the site through the next College Scorecard update

releases.label: IPEDS winter release (provisional), residence year
releases.basis: Colleges report residence in even-numbered falls; fall 2024's (EF2024C) came with the winter release in December 2025 (file dated Dec 30, 2025)
releases.note: Fall 2025's residence (EF2025C, winter 2026) is optional for colleges, so the site skips it

releases.label: College Scorecard update
brings: Refreshed IPEDS-derived enrollment and cost figures
releases.basis: Irregular: the last updates were Jun 10, 2026 and Mar 23, 2026

releases.label: College class profiles, fall 2026
brings: Newest acceptance rates, from each college's website
releases.basis: Colleges post them on their own websites, on a rolling basis each fall
releases.note: Not on the site yet: arrives with college-reported figures

releases.label: Common Data Set 2026–27
releases.basis: Colleges publish on a rolling basis
releases.note: Imported for colleges that publish the spreadsheet version

watching.name: IPEDS Admissions and Consumer Transparency Supplement (ACTS)
watching.summary: Detailed admissions data (by race, sex, family income, test scores and GPA) for 2019–20 through 2025–26, collected from colleges Dec 2025 to spring 2026. The Department of Education said it would publish in summer 2026.
watching.latest: No public file on NCES as of the date above. Part of the collection is blocked in court for 170+ colleges, and a new Federal Register notice (Sep 14, 2026) covers 2026–27.
watching.why: If published college by college, it could bring fall 2025 admissions for every four-year college before the regular winter release.
